apps.name: Featherwright
apps.localizedDescription: Featherwright is a free on-device iOS application manager/installer built with UIKit for quality. A community-driven fork of Feather — same bundle ID, so you can switch between them freely.
apps.subtitle: On-device signing application

news.title: About Featherwright
news.caption:
Featherwright is a community-driven fork of Feather, maintained by Calvin Moon. It allows you to use an Apple Developer Account to sign and install applications on device without needing a computer on stock iOS versions, while allowing easy management with its applications.

Featherwright keeps the same bundle identifier as Feather, so you can install it over Feather (and back) while keeping your certificates, signed apps, and settings. Rejected contributions from upstream are welcome here!
